subject: Meldung einer Nebenwirkung - Cardiozan
body_text:
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,

hiermit melde ich eine unerwuenschte Arzneimittelwirkung.

Die Patientin ist 61 Jahre alt, weiblich, 74 kg. Sie nimmt seit dem 05. Februar 2026 Cardiozan 20 mg einmal taeglich oral ein.

Am 19. Februar 2026 entwickelte sie starke Kopfschmerzen und Schwindel. Sie wurde nicht stationaer aufgenommen. Das Praeparat wurde abgesetzt und die Beschwerden sind zurueckgegangen.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen
Dr Markus Hoffmann, Praxis Hoffmann, Muenchen, Deutschland

documents.summary: This document is a synthetic adverse drug reaction reporting form (Form SYN-AE-01) intended solely for test purposes. The patient is a 61-year-old female weighing 74 kg with a medical history of hypertension known for many years. The reporter is Dr. Markus Hoffmann, a physician in private practice in Germany. The product involved is Cardiozan, taken orally at a dose of 20 mg once daily starting on February 5, 2026. On February 19, 2026, the patient experienced severe headache and dizziness after taking the medication. The outcome was that the complaints resolved, and the event was categorized as non-serious with no hospital admission required. The laboratory test table highlights a high white cell count at 11.8 x10^9/L compared to the reference range of 4.0 to 11.0. The table also shows high eosinophils at 0.9 x10^9/L and high C-reactive protein at 24 mg/L. Hemoglobin and platelet counts were listed as normal. The document does not state any concomitant medications. The document does not state any action taken regarding Cardiozan. Dechallenge and rechallenge details are not stated. The exact resolution date for the adverse event is not stated. Patient identification numbers or initials are not stated.
